subject.title: [Bug] Race condition in approval-classifier.ts when tokenization exceeds max tokens

question: Does the ACP protocol or current SDK expose any path where OpenClaw can process a tool effect before the awaited permission response, despite the reported tokenization mechanism being absent?
rationale: Resolving a claimed approval bypass requires direct owner knowledge or protocol-level evidence; speculative synchronization could alter ACP ordering without fixing a real defect.

options.title: Require protocol reproduction
options.body: Ask for a redacted payload, SDK/version details, and ordered protocol trace or regression test before accepting this as a vulnerability.

options.title: Perform owner-led security audit
options.body: Have an ACP owner audit all permission-pending callbacks and session-update paths before deciding whether defensive serialization is warranted.

recommendation.title: Require protocol reproduction
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted payload, SDK/version details, and ordered protocol trace or regression test before accepting this as a vulnerability.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior work directly changed ACP permission request semantics and they are already connected to this issue's timeline.
